skillFull: Floats forward at given intervals, dropping Sweet Powder Jellies. Occasionally, a Little Lump falls amongst the Powder. Level Up for more points for Sweet Powder Jellies and Cream Bun Jellies.
story: Once upon a time, there once lived a great pâtissier whose desserts brought tears of joy to the eyes of all Cookies that had the privilege of eating their desserts. These Cookies were so moved by the desserts' unbelievable flavors that they were unable to eat desserts baked by another ever again. However, the pâtissier's arrogance came back to bite them, as the god of baking placed a curse upon them... Now, the once great baker is no more than a soft, round cream bun! Bread Fairy is absolutely convinced that making Angel Chiffon Cookie into the greatest pâtissière will break the curse, turning them back into a Cookie. This confectionery companion never holds back in using magic to help the Cookie in her baking. What a reliable helper... or are they?

costumes.name: Soft Strawberry Rice Cake
costumes.info: Bread Fairy only ever intended to browse the strawberry festival's various desserts... but it got drawn in by delicious strawberry cream rice cakes, where it stuffed its cheeks until it was noticed by the festival-going Cookies! Now it's fluttering about, yelling about its baking greatness while dodging the hands of Cookies who think it is just another rice cake! Maybe it should just leave the rice cake corner...

costumes.name: Raspberry Hood
costumes.info: When making desserts, you have to wear a headscarf to keep things nice and clean! Angel Chiffon Cookie made a tiny hood just for Bread Fairy, who is so small that she used a little wild raspberry to make it. Seeing it so pleased makes all that wandering through the mountains in search of the perfect raspberry worth it!
